text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] GPU pool 'gpu-general-2' high utilization (95%) + sustained queue growth detected. Pager PAGER-1192 triggered at 03:12 UTC. Affected region: eu-west1. Potential capacity exhaustion. Noted error pattern in driver logs (Xid / OOM). @sam oncall notified.

mira (oncall): I'm live. seeing queue ~420 requests, avg wait ~4.8s but tail >> 10s. Autoscaler not adding nodes — requests to cloud API hitting rate-limit. Starting triage.

sam (sre): taking handoff from mira. Quick check: controller reports 3 nodes flapping (gpu-az-7, gpu-az-3, gpu-az-9). Repeated CUDA Xid 79 + driver OOM spikes. Likely runtime instability reducing usable capacity.

dave (infra): grabbing dmesg + driver logs from gpu-az-7. snippet:
```
[  103.451234] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1): 79, pid=4123, Voluntary_oom: gpu_mem_alloc failed
[  103.451240] kernel: Out of memory: container "serving-gpu-12" invoked oom-killer
[  104.003000] docker: failed to start runtime: runc did not start: exit status 1
```

mira (oncall): (thinking aloud) mitigation options: 1) cordon/drain flapping nodes 2) route low-priority traffic to fallback pools 3) attempt driver rollback or upgrade depending on success rate. Executing cordon on gpu-az-7 after confirming impact.

sre-lead: prioritize draining. If autoscaler still stuck, we may temporarily scale down batch/worker counts to reduce pressure. Also prepare customer comms.

dave (infra): cordon + drain initiated for gpu-az-7 and gpu-az-3. Evictions in progress. Note: autoscaler API returning 429 for scale up requests (rate limit). Opening support ticket with cloud.

julia (support): customers seeing spike: enterprise-acct-1 and fin-app-prod reported >10s completion latency and failures. Marking IMPACT-233. Notifying account teams and sending initial advisory.

sam (sre): starting a controlled driver rollout to attempt a stable driver variant (525.60 -> known to avoid Xid 79 on similar hardware). Command: 
```bash
kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/gpu-driver -l driver=525.60
kubectl -n serving scale deployment/gpu-worker --replicas=0 && sleep 8 && kubectl -n serving scale deployment/gpu-worker --replicas=4
```
ops-bot: Deploy job dj-8891 started by sam at 03:25 UTC.

dave (infra): driver rollout status: 2/5 nodes rolled successfully (gpu-az-1, gpu-az-2). 3 nodes failing with OOM on init, hitting kernel OOMs during module load. Rolling those back to previous stable driver to keep them online.

mira (oncall): because autoscaler can't provision fast enough (cloud quota/rate limit), I'm enabling routing policy 'soft-throttle' for non-critical routes and offloading embeddings to cpu-pool temporarily. Pushing config change now.

sam (sre): ran quick health-check after reroutes + partial rollback: queue dropped from 420 -> 120 in ~10m. Tail latency improved but still above SLO at ~2.6s p95. Continuing monitoring.

dave (infra): cloud API errors are 429/403 for new nodes; account team engaged. ETA unknown but likely 30-60m depending on support. Meanwhile, pinned flapping nodes to maintenance to avoid churn.

julia (support): posted update to impacted customers: workaround (retries, reduce concurrency) and ETA ~45m for stabilization. Logging customer responses; no escalations yet.

sam (sre): manual mitigation summary: cordoned 2 nodes, drained 2, rolled back driver on 3 failing nodes, enabled fallback routes, scaled down non-critical workers. These got queue down to 90 and reduced error spikes.

mira (oncall): still seeing intermittent Xid entries from one remaining older node; will keep it cordoned. Keeping incident P1 for now but escalating to P0 if customer failures increase.

ops-bot: Incident timeline note added by sam: "driver instability + autoscaler rate limits -> capacity exhaustion; mitigations: node cordon/drain, driver rollback, fallback routing, support ticket to cloud."

sam (sre): next steps: 1) await cloud response for new node provisioning 2) full driver validation in canary 3) add autoscaler retry/backoff improvements to avoid hitting hard rate limits 4) postmortem owner: sam.

julia (support): I'll keep comms cadence every 30m. Current customer impact: degraded latency for two enterprise customers, limited failures for others.

mira (oncall): marking oncall handoff to sam at 04:05 UTC; I'll stay in support channel if needed. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: PAGER-1192 status -> acknowledged -> mitigated (partial). Further updates will be appended to thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
